description: 한국서부발전(주)_태양광 발전 현황 [electricity and power] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국서부발전(주). 한국서부발전 태양광 발전 시설의 시간별 인버터출력 태양광 발전 정보 입니다. 태양광 발전정보 데이터는 태양광 설비에서 발생한 전력을 실시간에 가깝게 기록하여 발전 효율과 운영 상태를 분석할 수 있도록 정리한 자료입니다. 이 데이터에는 발전설비별 시간대별 발전량 등이 포함되며, 일사량과 기상 조건에 따른... Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국서부발전(주). Its tags are 태양광, 태양광발전, 태양광출력, 세종시폐기물매립장태양광, 안산연성정수장태양광. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-09-24 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
